title: 第二十四章 捡钱系统第二十五章 比太监都娘
content_zh:
霖华仙尊毫不客气的发灵石，韩紫枫淡定的跟首长说：“供应灵石，欲购从速啊喂。”
韩家人也是没叫紫枫失望，第二天一早，韩家人就嚣张的出现在紫枫的面前，张嘴第一句就是：“身为韩家人，这种能换修炼资源的傀儡，你怎么能不交给家族？”
紫枫淡定一刀：“是你们合伙把我赶出去的好吧？你们是真有脸过来，再说，我之前不是跟首长说，叫你们管海外吗？”
韩家人冲着她咆哮：“那个管家给出的东西，限制也忒大啦。还有神龙，那边完全没有，凭什么区别待遇。”
紫枫很淡定的问：“不是，你们当不当自己是华人？西方有限制，很正常吧？把那些异族养肥了，不是给自己找麻烦吗？再说神龙，你是把自己当人皇啦？气运金龙这个东西，除去人皇，其他人要，那是想造反啊！话说，我还真有一条，不过，那是打架专用的好吧。”
韩家人还想说什么，看着过来的首长，她说：“我不管啦，这种明显通敌叛国的，自己搞定，还有，既然韩家这个代销商不能启用啦，那你们就自己研究外销的事情，反正东西都给你们研究出来啦，就别叫我惆怅昂，那句话怎么说的来着？哦对，能混就混，不能混就死呗。”
有这话丢在哪里，首长表示：“行啦，我知道怎么操作啦。对西方，你能说的更明确点不？”
紫枫淡定的问：“信仰之争，你个当皇帝的不用我解释吧？不用吧？找着是这个方向来，找着这个方面忽悠，总之就是，能拐卖，就拐卖，你们当这些东西都是白用的，这些都是有因果的，虽然你们不见得能被利用上，但那些西方的，完全可以拉过来，顶顶锅。对上面那个发钱的来说，西方那群，就是信仰之争的牺牲品。我说的够不够明白？明确？实行交给你们。”
首长表示：完全理解中心思想，交给他们坑就完事啦。
这里的事情交代完成，看着韩家的大多数人被清理掉，毕竟韩家还是有一些，比较靠谱，比较华夏的弟子，结果，处理起来也很简单，想去国外混的，那就直接改国籍，别回来就完事啦，实在是知道太多的，那就是买个凶，暗戳戳的弄死就完事啦。
这些事情，紫枫看到就当没看到，并且直接要了一片地皮，并且是上面有房子的小区。首长问：“亲，告诉一下，你想干嘛呗？”
紫枫淡定的回答：“开小区，收房租，关键是，我打算再附近弄个大型的聚灵阵，剩下的事情也就是维护，如果维护都维护不明白，自己买豆腐去，撞死算啦。”
首长也是这么认为的，如果维护都维护不明白，那真是死了算啦。就这样，地方很快到位，接着就是布阵，然后就是一群修士直接搬家到这里，紫枫更是给几个首长都在准备了房子。这样的话，他们天天跟着混，也能确保身体健康，益寿年年。
等这边都处理明白后，紫枫也就不管后续啦，她要的房子，直接一个电脑，剩下也就不管啦。另一边，她本着闲着也是闲着的原则，打算跑去港岛那边，看看能不能弄点签名啥的。
反正那边也是有房的，休闲，就要休闲到位啊。叫紫枫有点疑惑的是，她的房客们，还真有港岛的，于是，这个哥们就带这个她，围观那些明星，真的能做到，一呼百应。
紫枫开心的把一堆老古董一样的明星扒出来，现买本，现签名，依旧只有华叔一家，待遇比较好，紫枫甚至丢给霖华仙尊一个问题：“提问：有给凡人吃的，能返老返童的物品，大于年轻个三十岁左右，从里到外的年轻那种。”
霖华仙尊淡定回答：“这里有息壤兑水，一瓶可分给是个凡人吃，记得再兑点水。；驻颜丹，这个只能外貌看着年轻，对身体上的疾病，没什么实质性的办法；造化丹，太老吃着浪费。”
紫枫说啥，用体验点买就完事啦，她是开心的来到华叔家做客，并要求把他们家的大龄亲戚，都给叫上，等吃完饭，紫枫开心的拿出是个杯子，一个杯子分一两滴的息壤水，然后再次兑水。
紫枫淡定说：“一人一杯，你们的母亲两杯，干杯。”
一群人喝完，嗯嗯，顿时大叔变小伙，一家人彼此看看，都是很疑惑啊！紫枫淡定的回答：“呵呵，你们就当仙露，现在你们基本身体状况，再二十，三十岁状态，加油活，奥利给，大叔等看电影，加油。”

华叔很无语，可看着返老返童的一家人，他更加的无语，这个要怎么编？紫枫歪头，咳咳：“自己编。”一家人能说啥，粉丝福利很彪悍啊！紫枫也不客气直接更奇姐申请：“姐，能拐你男人除去玩几天不，咱需要个认识路的啊喂。”
奇姐到时很开心的表示：“一起啊！”
紫枫一脸质疑的说：“坚决不逛街，不压马路，人家要去吃吃吃，玩玩玩。”一家人再次不厚道的笑啦。接下来的一个月时间，紫枫也真就是纯玩，真就是吃喝玩乐，愣是把奇姐和小妹整不会了啦，这是纯玩啊！
眼看放假结束，霖华仙尊再次踹她开工：“叮，请重新抽取新的系统。”
看到熟悉的转盘，紫枫能说啥：“随机抽。”
“叮，捡钱系统每天固定奖励1点体验点，商城已更新。捡钱系统新手大礼包已发放。”紫枫看着新手礼包，嗯嗯100点潜能点，再看看自己的状态：
姓名：韩紫枫。性别：女。
体质：107（筑基期300）。
力量：106（筑基期300）。
速度：106（筑基期300）。
韧性：106（筑基期300）。
智力：106（筑基期300）。
魅力：100。
悟性：100。
气运：100+40。
武功：太极拳、太极剑、梯云纵、北冥神功、长春功、弹指神通、御剑术。
content_en:
Immortal Linhua unceremoniously handed out the spirit stone, and Han Zifeng calmly said to the leader: "We are supplying spirit stones. If you want to buy them, hurry up."
The Han family did not disappoint Zifeng. Early the next morning, the Han family appeared arrogantly in front of Zifeng. The first thing they said when they opened their mouths was: "As a member of the Han family, how can you not hand over this kind of puppet that can be exchanged for cultivation resources to the family?"
Zifeng said calmly: "You guys worked together to drive me out, right? You really have the nerve to come here. Besides, didn't I tell the chief before that I told you to take care of overseas affairs?"
The Han family roared at her: "The things that the housekeeper gave are too restrictive. There are also divine dragons, which are not available there at all, so why should we treat them differently?"
Zifeng asked very calmly: "No, do you think you are Chinese? There are restrictions in the West, is it normal? If you fatten up those foreign races, aren't you causing trouble for yourself? Besides, Shenlong, do you think of yourself as the Human Emperor? If anyone else wants the Luck Golden Dragon except the Human Emperor, it is because they want to rebel! By the way, I do have one, but it is only for fighting, okay?"
What else the Han family wanted to say, looked at the leader who came over, and she said: "I don't care. Those who are obviously treasonous and treasonous should be dealt with by themselves. Also, since the Han family cannot be used as an agent, then you should study the export business yourself. Anyway, everything has been researched for you, so don't call me melancholy. How do you say that? Oh yes, if you can, you can mix, and if you can't, you will die."
With these words thrown away, the chief said: "Okay, I know how to operate it. Can you be more clear about the West?"
Zifeng asked calmly: "In the battle of faith, you, the emperor, don't need me to explain it? No need? You are looking for this direction, looking for this aspect to fool you. In short, if you can abduct and sell, you can abduct and sell. You think these things are in vain. These all have cause and effect." Yes, although you may not be able to be exploited, those in the West can definitely take the blame. As for the people above, those in the West are the victims of the battle of faith. Am I clear enough? I’ll leave it to you.”
The chief said: I fully understand the central idea, just leave it to them.
The affairs here were completed and most of the people in the Han family were cleared out. After all, the Han family still has some disciples who are more reliable and more Chinese. As a result, it is very simple to deal with. If you want to live abroad, just change your nationality and don't come back. If you really know too much, you can just buy a murderer and kill them secretly.
When Zifeng saw these things, he pretended not to have seen them, and directly asked for a piece of land, and it was a community with houses on it. The chief asked: "Dear, tell me, what do you want to do?"
Zifeng replied calmly: "Open a community and collect rent. The key is that I plan to build a large spirit gathering array nearby. The only thing left is maintenance. If you don't understand the maintenance, just buy tofu yourself and you will be killed."
The chief also thinks so. If the maintenance staff can't understand it, then they are really dead. In this way, the place was quickly arrived, followed by the formation, and then a group of monks moved directly here. Zifeng even prepared houses for several leaders. In this way, by following them every day, they can ensure good health and live longer.
After everything is settled here, Zifeng will not care about the follow-up. The house she wants is just a computer, and she will not care about the rest. On the other side, based on the principle that idleness is also idle, she planned to run to Hong Kong Island to see if she could get some autographs or something.
Anyway, there are rooms over there, so for leisure, you have to have enough leisure time. What makes Zifeng a little confused is that her tenants are actually from Hong Kong Island, so this buddy took her to watch the celebrities, and she was really able to do it, and she responded to everything.
Zifeng happily took a bunch of oldCelebrities like Dong were picked out and bought copies and signed them. It was still only Hua Shu's family who was treated better. Zifeng even threw a question to Immortal Lin Hua: "Question: There are food for mortals, items that can rejuvenate youth, which are better than those who are about thirty years old, young from the inside out."
Immortal Linhua replied calmly: "There is breath soil mixed with water here. One bottle can be distributed to a mortal. Remember to mix some water.; Zhuyan Pill, this only looks young in appearance, and has no real solution to physical diseases; Good Fortune Pill, it is wasted when you are too old to eat it."
Zifeng said, just use the experience points to buy it. She happily came to Uncle Hua's house as a guest and asked to call all their older relatives. After finishing the meal, Zifeng happily took out a cup, filled each cup with one or two drops of soil water, and then mixed it with water again.
Zifeng said calmly: "One cup for each person, two cups for your mother, cheers."
After a group of people finished drinking, eh, eh, the uncle suddenly turned into a young man, and the whole family looked at each other, all very confused! Zifeng replied calmly: "Haha, just treat it as fairy dew. Your basic physical condition is now in your twenties or thirties. Come on, Oli is here. Uncle, wait and watch the movie. Come on."
Uncle Hua was speechless, but looking at the family that had reverted back to old age, he was even more speechless. How should I make this up? Zifeng tilted his head and coughed: "Make it up yourself." What can the family say? The fan welfare is very strong! Zifeng was not polite and directly asked Sister Qi to apply: "Sister, can I kidnap your man and play with him for a few days? We need someone who knows the way."
When Sister Qi arrived, she happily said, "Let's go together!"
Zifeng said with a questioning look on her face: "I will definitely not go shopping or walk on the street. I am going to eat and have fun." The family laughed unkindly again. In the next month, Zifeng was really just playing, eating, drinking and having fun. He was so surprised that he couldn't deal with Sister Qi and the younger sister. This was just for fun!
Seeing that the holiday was over, Immortal Linhua kicked her again and started working: "Ding, please draw a new system again."
Seeing the familiar turntable, what could Zifeng say: "Draw randomly."
"Ding, the money-picking system rewards 1 experience point every day, and the mall has been updated. The money-picking system novice gift pack has been distributed." Zifeng looked at the novice gift pack, hmm, 100 potential points, and then looked at his status:
